Corporate Action - Record Date For First Interim Dividend 2026-27
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Meeting Of The Board

analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong start to Q1 FY27, with pre-sales growing 567% year-on-year to INR 409 crores and profit after tax increasing 77% to INR 46 crores. The company launched two new projects during the quarter and plans to launch four more over the remainder of FY27, targeting a combined GDV of INR 3,500 to 4,000 crores. Management reiterated its FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR 1,800 to 2,000 crores and expects to maintain strong profitability with EBITDA margins of 35% to 40%. The company continues to maintain a net cash balance sheet with a total cash balance of approximately INR 776 crores. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited published its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting strong operational performance.

guidance.claim: Sri Lotus is committed to its FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR 1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to sustain strong profitability with EBITDA margins of 35% to 40% and PAT margins of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: Sri Lotus intends to collect around INR 1,000 crores in cash collections this year.
guidance.quote: So, this year we are intend to collect around INR1,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The company plans to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27 with an estimated combined GDV of ~INR 3,500–4,000 Crs.
guidance.quote: The company plans to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27, with an estimated combined GDV of ~INR 3,500–4,000 Crs.

guidance.claim: The company expects to launch three projects in H1 FY2027 with a combined revenue potential of over INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we expect to launch three projects in H1 FY2027, Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, Lotus Trident, and Lotus Sky Plaza in Andheri, with a combined revenue potential of over INR2,500 crores to INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: For the full year, the company has a launch pipeline of six projects with an estimated GDV of INR 5,000 crores to INR 5,500 crores.
guidance.quote: For the full year, we have a robust launch pipeline of six projects, Lotus Aquaria, Lotus Trident, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with an estimated GDV of INR5,000 crores to INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving its FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR 1,800 crores to INR 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this robust launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident in its ability to sign four to six new projects in the coming year.
guidance.quote: Overall traction remains encouraging and our inquiry pipeline continues to be strong, giving us confidence in our ability to sign four to six new projects in the coming year and further expand our portfolio in a calibrated manner.

guidance.claim: The company expects marketing efforts to be less than 1% of its revenue.
guidance.quote: So yes, we will be doing marketing efforts and it would be less than 1% of our revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury real estate buyers are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle rather than loan rates.
demand_outlook.quote: They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11% despite moderation in the overall housing market.
demand_outlook.quote: Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained.

demand_outlook.claim: Most new luxury supply in Mumbai comes through redevelopment due to very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has seen a price rise of about 5% to 10% in its operating micro-markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So, as far as price rise is concerned, it's about 5% to 10% we have seen the price rise.

demand_outlook.claim: Sri Lotus experienced robust momentum and healthy demand for its luxury and ultra-luxury residential portfolio in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The first quarter of FY27 has marked a strong start for Sri Lotus Developers, with robust momentum across our business and continued healthy demand for our luxury and ultra-luxury residential portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The GIFT City project is seeing strong demand for Grade-A commercial spaces and high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: The luxury residential segment is outperforming the broader residential market.
demand_outlook.quote: Even amid global uncertainty and geopolitical developments, luxury residential segment is clearly outperforming the broader residential market, supported by robust end-user demand, rising aspirations, and sustained interest from HNIs and NRIs.

demand_outlook.claim: Buyers are increasingly preferring larger residences, enhanced amenities, wellness-focused living, and developments backed by trusted brands.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also witnessing strong absorption levels across key micro markets with buyers increasingly preferring larger residences, enhanced amenities, wellness-focused living, and developments backed by trusted brands.

demand_outlook.claim: Commercial demand is doing extremely well across all micro markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Commercial is doing extremely well across all the micro markets and residential in ultra-luxury also has a very strong demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's pricing in any micro market is about 10% to 25% higher than competitors.
demand_outlook.quote: And as you know our pricing in any micro market we are about 10 to 20, 25% higher than any other competitor.

capex_expansion.claim: Sri Lotus launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR 1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR 1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Sri Lotus plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR 3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to start the Juhu commercial redevelopment project next year.
capex_expansion.quote: And hopefully, we will be starting this project next year, after passing of plans, and other formalities.

capex_expansion.claim: Sri Lotus expects to get all approvals in place for its Gift City project by the end of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are expecting that by the end of this year, we'll get all our approvals in place.

capex_expansion.claim: Sri Lotus expanded its development portfolio by launching Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we further expanded our development portfolio with the launch of Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a Joint Development Agreement with profit sharing arrangement with Mr. Abhishek Bachchan for a mixed-use project in GIFT City Area.
capex_expansion.quote: Agreement type: Joint Development Agreement with profit sharing arrangement with Mr. Abhishek Bachchan

capex_expansion.claim: The company marked its strategic entry into GIFT City.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we also marked our strategic entry into GIFT City, further expanding our geographic presence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company executed development agreements for key projects including Lotus Portofino, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Odyssey, Lotus Avalon, Lotus Imperial, and a mixed-use development in GIFT City.
capex_expansion.quote: We executed development agreements for key projects, including Lotus Portofino at Versova, Lotus Sky Plaza at Oshiwara, Lotus Odyssey at Bandstand, Lotus Avalon in Juhu, Lotus Imperial in Bandra, as well as a mixed-use development in GIFT City.

capex_expansion.claim: Multiple societies have appointed Lotus as their preferred developer.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, multiple societies have appointed Lotus as their preferred developer, such as Lotus Upper Crest at Bandra, Lotus Insignia, and Lotus Orion, reflecting growing trust in our brand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched four projects during the year: Amalfi, The Arcadian, Varun, and Celestia.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we launched four projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian, Varun, and Celestia.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR 46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR 48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with an EBITDA margin of 36.4% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects its marketing expenses to be approximately 1% of pre-sales.
margins_costs.quote: Of course, our expense would be I would say about 1% approximately, but that also will be able to recover because what happens that during this advertising, there would be many clients we will be getting directly, where we will not be spending any money on brokerage.

margins_costs.claim: The company targets a consistent PAT margin of approximately 25%-30%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin (%) ~ 25%-30% on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: Sri Lotus reported an EBITDA margin of 36.4% for Q1 FY27.
Input costs have risen by approximately 7%, while labor costs have increased by around 5%.
margins_costs.quote: Input costs have risen by approximately 7%, while labor costs have increased by around 5%.

margins_costs.claim: On an annualized basis, input and labor cost increases may translate into an approximate 1% increase in overall project cost.
margins_costs.quote: On an annualized basis, this may translate into a approximate 1% increase in overall project cost.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 39.4% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 39.4% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the full year stood at 36.5%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR281 crores with EBITDA margin at 36.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Total project cost increase from geopolitical tensions will not be more than 1.5% to 2.5%.
margins_costs.quote: But that cost increase in totality of the project will not be more than about 1.5% to 2.5%.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR 17,500 to 18,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the 22 projects in the pipeline, 17 are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

orders_capacity.claim: Sri Lotus has completed the plinth level for the Lotus Varun project.
orders_capacity.quote: Regarding that Varun, so we have just completed the plinth level.

orders_capacity.claim: The two projects launched during Q1 FY27 have a combined GDV of INR 1,350 Crs.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, these projects have a GDV of INR 1,350 Crs.

orders_capacity.claim: Sri Lotus launched Lotus Trident and Lotus Aquaria during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Two projects were launched during Q1 FY27 – Lotus Trident (Andheri West) and Lotus Aquaria (Prabhadevi).

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 462 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q4 FY26 stood at INR462 crores, registering a strong growth of 177% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Celestia achieved booking of INR 155 crores within 7 days of launch.
orders_capacity.quote: The quarter was marked by the successful launch of Lotus Celestia in Versova Beach, which achieved booking of INR155 crores within 7 days of launch, reflecting strong market acceptance.

orders_capacity.claim: For the full year ended March 2026, the company achieved pre-sales of INR 1,157 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: For the full year ended March 2026, we achieved pre-sales of INR1,157 crores, in line with our stated guidance, despite industry-wide challenges.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added nine new projects with a cumulative GDV of approximately INR 8,500 crores to INR 9,000 crores during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY26, we added nine new projects with a cumulative GDV of approximately INR8,500 crores to INR9,000 crores, significantly strengthening our development pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved sales of 62% in Amalfi, 41% in The Arcadian, and 38% in Varun within one year.
orders_capacity.quote: Within just 1-year, we have achieved sales of 62% in Amalfi, 41% in The Arcadian, and 38% in Varun, demonstrating strong sales velocity even across recent launches and reinforcing the quality and demand for our project.

capital_allocation.claim: Collections for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 150 crores, up by 115% year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: Collections stood at INR150 crores, up by 115% year-on-year.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a total cash balance of approximately INR 776 crores against debt of INR 153 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Sri Lotus raised approximately INR 792 crores through its IPO fresh issue, with net proceeds of approximately INR 732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On the deployment of IPO proceeds, we raised approximately INR792 crores through fresh issue, with net proceeds after issue expenses of approximately INR732 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has deployed INR 271 crores out of the INR 550 crores earmarked for its subsidiary as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has two years remaining to reduce the promoter stake from 82% to 75% or below.
capital_allocation.quote: One year has passed, so we have still two years to go.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allocated ~INR 550 Crs from IPO proceeds to invest in subsidiaries for funding ongoing project construction costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a dividend payout of 50% for FY26, with the promoter group voluntarily waiving its entitlement.
capital_allocation.quote: Before I conclude, I would like to share that the Board has approved a dividend payout of 50% for FY26. In line with its long-term growth vision, the promoter group has voluntarily waived its dividend entitlement for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The retained dividend amount will be utilized for new project additions and project development.
capital_allocation.quote: The retained amount will be utilized for new project additions and project development.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash as on March 31, 2026 stood at INR 697 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash as on 31st March 2026 stood at INR697 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds, the company deployed INR 394 crores till March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of this, we have deployed fund amounting to INR394 crores till March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected free cash flow from completed and ongoing projects stood at INR 3,103 crores, and from upcoming projects at INR 5,450 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Projected free cash flow from the completed and ongoing projects stood at INR3,103 crores, while projected free cash flow from upcoming projects stood at INR5,450 crores, taking a total projected surplus to INR8,553 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Most buyers globally are being cautious due to interest rates and broader uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's performance is subject to risks including Indian and international economic conditions, industry dynamics, competition, execution of strategy, and market risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing global geopolitical developments have led to a moderate increase in input and labor costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Before moving into the detailed financial, I would like to highlight that ongoing global geopolitical developments have led to a moderate increase in input and labor costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: A project in Ghatkopar is on final hearing at the Supreme Court due to a dispute between bungalow owners and the society.
risks_headwinds.quote: It's on final hearing at Supreme Court. There are some six bungalow owners and the society, they both have gone to the court.

risks_headwinds.claim: Two projects are taking more time to get approvals, including one involving an existing hospital.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is one is existing hospital. So we need to construct that hospital and get our sale area separately. So that's why it is taking a little more time.

management_commitments.claim: Sri Lotus is committed to its FY27 pre-sales guidance of INR 1,800 to 2,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to dilute the promoter stake within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: One year has passed, so we have still two years to go.

management_commitments.claim: Sri Lotus expects to complete the RCC work for Lotus Varun before January.
management_commitments.quote: Now, we have around 20 slabs, so we are confident before January we'll complete the RCC work and 90% of the work will be completed till March.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27 with an estimated combined GDV of ~INR 3,500–4,000 Crs.
management_commitments.quote: The company plans to launch four new projects in the remaining part of FY27, with an estimated combined GDV of ~INR 3,500–4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: The GIFT City Area flagship ultra luxury project has a targeted completion timeline of FY31.
The company is confident of achieving its FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR 1,800 crores to INR 2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by this robust launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we are confident of achieving our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue growth of 55% to 60% and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we expect to launch three projects in H1 FY2027, Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, Lotus Trident, and Lotus Sky Plaza in Andheri, with a combined revenue potential of over INR2,500 crores to INR3,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company is confident in its ability to sign four to six new projects in the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: Overall traction remains encouraging and our inquiry pipeline continues to be strong, giving us confidence in our ability to sign four to six new projects in the coming year and further expand our portfolio in a calibrated manner.
